messages:
maria: quick check — before we flip the unpinned default: what is the agreed deprecation/grace plan for older default clients? i want a short checklist we can point customers at.
kevin: short version: canary (5% traffic) 48h -> 25% 72h -> full flip after 7 days if no regressions. docs + SDK notice go out at T-14 days.
arpit: +1 on timeline. also we need a fallback path: if client uses no accept-model header, we should route to legacy variant for 30 days then 429? currently server returns new default.
jessica: are we doing an automatic shim in the gateway for response shape changes? i remember some embeddings/response-envelope differences.
maria: yes — propose a runtime shim that rewrites field names for old clients for the 30d grace window. but we need to call it out in the deprecation announcement.
kevin: action items: 1) update docs page with migration steps + example SDK snip. 2) add telemetry flag to detect clients without Accept-Model. 3) create gateway shim and feature flag.
arpit: SDK snippet we want in docs (typescript):
```ts
// opt-in new default explicitly
client = new RedwoodClient({ defaultModel: 'redwood-open-2' });
// or send header on requests
await client.request({ prompt, headers: { 'Accept-Model': 'redwood-open-2' } });
```
jessica: will the shim cover nested envelope changes (e.g., choices -> outputs)? we should be careful about tokens/counts and billing fields.
maria: shim will map outputs -> choices, and preserve token accounting by copying token fields 1:1. not doing model-level quality shims (that’s a hard problem).
kevin: monitoring checklist for canary: error rate, mean latency, token delta > 10%, QA prompt set regression (run nightly), and customer-facing 5-minute heartbeat on the rollout page.
arpit: how do we detect SDK versions? user-agent? prefer instrumentation in server side: look for "redwood-sdk/1." or missing Accept-Model header. devx-bot: created analytics segment 'no_accept_model' for this.
maria: perfect — include that segment in the deprecation dashboard. also we need to draft the announcement: quick deprecation timeline, rollback instructions, contact SRE if latency > 2x.
jessica: for rollback: gating is automated by the rollout service; if any of these trigger (error rate spike, token delta, QA failures) we auto-rollback to previous routing within 5m. ensure runbooks updated.
kevin: runbooks: i'll add entries under eng-platform/runbooks/model-rollout.md and link them from the dashboard.
arpit: one more: client-side migration helper we can ship as a tiny npm package that adds Accept-Model header and optional response-envelope compatibility mode. would cut customer effort.
maria: love that. devx-bot: created ticket DX-4823 for npm helper and SDK patch.
kevin: timeline sync: docs + SDK warnings at T-14, telemetry collection enabled at T-10, npm helper alpha at T-7, gateway shim behind flag T-3, canary T+0.
jessica: pinging @kevin for final wording for rollback thresholds — will post a PR to the runbook shortly. :eyes:
kevin: will do, PR by EOD.
maria: final ask — can each of you drop a 1-line update in #eng-releases when your task is complete so we have a flat audit? saves manual chasing.
arpit: will add a badge to the release page once shim deploys.
kevin: deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled for 3460014000 (5% traffic)
deploy-bot: deployment queued: canary | service=router-gateway | version=canary-2026-03-17 | start=3460014000
maria: thanks all — this thread is my source of truth for the next 48h. I will assemble the public comms draft and share for review.
